extra.reason: Server never sends OBS password over WS. Password stays server-side; browser sends OBS_CONNECT message, server decrypts and connects itself.
CSRF token now requires authenticated Clerk session. Token format is userId:randomBytes, validated against the authenticated user. /api/csrf returns 401 for unauthenticated requests.
